Description
This is Volume 9 of the martial arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也), officially licensed and published in Taiwan by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社).
This classic volume captures the series’ trademark energy — a mix of martial arts action, humor, and heart. Originally serialized in Japan, the Kung Fu Boy series became a major hit across Asia and remains a nostalgic favorite for manga collectors today.
